metadata.summary: Jitin ordered a Breakfast Bundle from Manhattan Bagel with a customized selection of bagels and discussed the cream cheese options.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?

Yeah. I want to, go with five sesame, five garlic, one vanilla, and, two, everything they do.
